summary: Backend-only hotfix verification (iteration 7). Focused on: (1) JWT regression in backend/core/security.py::_user_from_jwt (malformed/forged/expired/missing-sub/empty-sub/wrong-type tokens must return 401, never 500), (2) admin gating (customer 403, admin 200, forged admin token 401), (3) Prime/Prime+ subscription enforcement per pubg_id incl. cart validation, UC never blocked, cancel/failed release the lock, /orders/subscriptions filters correctly, (4) concurrent duplicate POST /api/orders yields exactly one 201 and seven 409 via unique (pubg_id,type) index on subscription_locks. All 23 targeted tests pass. Existing suite (backend_test.py + test_subscription_rule.py etc.) not re-run per main-agent instructions.
critical_code_review_comments: security.py::_user_from_jwt correctly guards against missing/empty 'sub' and wrong 'type' claim before hitting Mongo — the fix is verified.
backend/tests/backend_test.py lines 24-26 now source ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD via dotenv_values from backend/.env (no hardcoded creds) — verified.
orders.reserve_subscription: atomic insert on unique (pubg_id,type) index + stale-lock reclaim is correct; concurrency test confirms exactly-one-winner (1x201, 7x409).
orders.create_order lines 160-164 correctly reject multi-Prime carts and quantity>1 on subscriptions (400).
release_subscription_locks is invoked on admin cancel/failed transitions and on admin delete — verified lock release allows re-order.
test_credentials: admin: admin@magicgame.store / Admin12345! (from backend/.env). Fresh customers registered via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Created several qa_it7_*@test.mg customer accounts and a handful of test orders (Prime/Prime+/UC) with random 10-digit pubg_ids and matching subscription_locks. Safe test data, prefixed for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New targeted regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_hotfix.py covers JWT edge cases + Prime/Prime+ + concurrency. Re-run with: pytest backend/tests/test_iter7_hotfix.py -v. Uses BACKEND_TEST_URL env (defaults localhost:8001) because external ingress may 404 on /api/*. JWT_SECRET is read from backend/.env to forge test tokens.
rca of the issue: N/A — hotfix works as intended. Prior risk was that _user_from_jwt could pass a payload without 'sub' to db.users.find_one({'user_id': None}) which returns None (harmless) or a payload with wrong 'type' being accepted; the new guard (payload.get('type')!='access' or not payload.get('sub') -> return None) correctly forces a 401 in get_current_user.
